symptom: check refused nanoflow data sources (and actions) whose argument came from the enclosing snippet's or page's parameter on a 9.24 project, which mx check 9.24 accepts at 0 errors
cause: the CE1571 rule was measured on 11.13 only, where a page parameter does not supply the argument, and applied to every version
insight: Bisect a behaviour change instead of assuming the major-version boundary: the issue assumed '9.x vs 10+', but 10.0.0 still accepts and 10.1.0 refuses. One script holding every shape (snippet param, page param, data source, button action) and a bisect.sh that downloads an mxbuild, makes a fresh app, writes the script, runs mx check and deletes the mxbuild gets each step to a few minutes and keeps disk bounded. The CDN listing for '10.1' prefix-matches 10.19.x; ask for three-part 10.1.0 to get 10.1's own builds.
